attempts.label: c1-tb-all
attempts.shape: one canvas, 3 diagrams, every diagram tb

check.labels: 21/23 placed, 0 leader-ticked, 0 on route, 2 skipped, 1 ambiguous owners

attempts.why: tb turns each long verb label into a rank gap as tall as the text is wide: the request section alone measured 39x150 and the canvas 162x257. Two labels had no free slot (create/terminate/repair, reinstall/reprovision) and boot.ipxe + S3 args had an ambiguous owner against its anti-parallel partner. Raw output: recorded/c1-tb-all.stdout and .stderr.
